# AI Slop Code Risk Monitor

> Empirical repository scan findings and heuristic code-review indicators, not proof of AI authorship or vulnerabilities.

## Evidence and interpretation

SynthScan records pattern findings, scan coverage and, where available, heuristic indices for cognitive ownership, dependency/supply-chain review and PR review effort. These are not measured comprehension, verified hallucinated packages or observed review velocity. Compare compatible scoring versions and inspect the underlying findings before citing results.

## Current snapshot

Generated: 2026-11-18 08:28 UTC. Successful repository scans: 7207.

Unweighted mean heuristic indices (0–100), grouped by schema / engine / scoring version; only scans with positive lines and files and complete versions contribute:

- Cognitive ownership: mean 13.95/100 across 7205 repositories; versions 1.0.0 / 2.0.0 / heuristic-density-v1.
- Dependency and supply-chain: mean 4.74/100 across 7205 repositories; versions 1.0.0 / 2.0.0 / heuristic-density-v1.
- PR review effort: mean 22.29/100 across 7205 repositories; versions 1.0.0 / 2.0.0 / heuristic-density-v1.
